question: Why did Jesus heal the paralyzed man in front of the Pharisees?
options: So they would know the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins
To show the Law of Moses was wrong
Because they asked him for a sign
To prove the man's friends were right
explanation: Jesus said, 'I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,' and then he healed the man.
